//: Shared, committed project settings: policy + hooks. Personal allowlists belong in settings.local.json (gitignored). Secret-file reads are enforced here via permissions.deny; ../.aiignore mirrors the same patterns for AI tools that honor .aiignore instead of this file.

env.//: token-guard threshold (lines) — see hooks/pre-read-token-guard.sh; override per-person in settings.local.json

hooks.//: token guard: block whole-file dumps of large files; redirect to sliced reads or the bulk-read skill (haiku Explore)
auto-setup githooks — this repo uses .githook (singular), installed by 'mvn initialize'
hooks.command: test "$(git config --get core.hooksPath)" = .githook || { git config core.hooksPath .githook && echo 'restored core.hooksPath -> .githook (project hooks were disabled)'; }

hooks.//: auto-feed Claude the latest git changes
hooks.command:
printf '## Repo state
Branch: %s

Uncommitted changes:
%s

Last 5 commits:
%s
' "$(git branch --show-current)" "$(git status --short)" "$(git log --oneline -5)"

SessionStart.//: warn when other Claude Code sessions share this checkout; suggest EnterWorktree

hooks.//: after a .java/.kt edit: flag FQCNs and files misplaced under src/main/kotlin
